title: General coordinate-fold fibre profile and minimal residual Return audit
question: For the coordinatewise fold from 2m addresses to 2m-1 addresses in dimension d, what is the exact fibre profile and what residual information is necessary and sufficient for exact Return?
authority_boundary: Internal bounded formal-design evidence only. This audit proves the finite coordinate-fold and Return statements it explicitly defines. It does not recover a historical visual generator, establish a physical cube or channel mechanism, complete the full Grid-Fold-Channel specification, admit A0-BL-025 as a Study, create a Navigator identity, or authorize publication.

fold.one_coordinate: q_m(i)=i for i<=m-1; q_m(i)=i-1 for i>=m

declared_tests: prove and exhaustively verify that a target with k central coordinates has fibre size 2^k
prove and exhaustively verify that the number of such targets is C(d,k)(2m-2)^(d-k)
verify target and source cardinality identities
construct exact Return from the target plus one bit for each central coordinate
verify the pointwise k-bit and uniform d-bit lower bounds by fibre cardinality
recover the 64-to-63 profiles in dimensions one, two and three
run non-identical controls m=1,d=4 and m=2,d=3
state the exact TripleSix capacity boundary
stop_rules: Do not identify the declared fold with a historical visual generator.
Do not infer a physical fold, channel or cube mechanism.
Do not claim that a six-state TripleSix carrier reconstructs an eight-state simultaneous three-axis fibre.
Do not mark the full A0-BL-025 Grid-Fold-Channel backlog item complete.
Do not create a new Study, Family, canonical Navigator identity or publication state.
